import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embedding_dim, num_heads, max_seq_length):
        super().__init__()
        self.silu = nn.SiLU()
        self.multihead_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embedding_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.register_buffer(
            "attn_mask", torch.triu(torch.ones(max_seq_length, max_seq_length) * float("-inf"), diagonal=1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.silu(x)
        x, _ = self.multihead_attn(x, x, x, attn_mask=self.attn_mask)
        return x

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, output_padding, bias_shape):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_transpose = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            in_channels,
            out_channels,
            kernel_size,
            stride=stride,
            padding=padding,
            output_padding=output_padding,
            bias=True,
        )
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(bias_shape))

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv_transpose(x) + self.bias
        x = torch.clamp(x, min=0.0, max=1.0)
        x = F.gelu(x)
        x = torch.max(x, dim=1)
        return x

class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, scale_factor, mode, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.scale_factor = scale_factor
        self.mode = mode
        self.in_channels = in_channels

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads, comparison_value):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.comparison_value = comparison_value

    def forward(self, q, k, v, mask=None):
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=mask)
        x = torch.lt(x, self.comparison_value)
        return x
